attributes.problem_statement:
## Headline ##
- Cardano enters into a new era of growth needing a message protocol scalable for social, defi and technical Use Cases. 
- Cardano's Network layer **Ouroboros** services the business of block dispersion, transaction routing, peer to peer connectivity and is optimised for transport.
- This proposal centres on solving an bi-directional communication gap between DApps to their Users, Users to Users and DApps to broader applications
- By enabling a communication capability, communication can occur as:
- - a broadcast feed which can facilitate updates on Governance Actions, Marketing events, App-specific alerts and notifications
- - a point to point communication where an app user can communicate with other users in the ecosystem or other users, or indeed the DApp itself has a point to point conversation
- - AI based query can be submitted and information retrieved, providing value across the communication channel
- Focusing on wallets (embedded or solely), and establishing these communication mechanism does not need to burden the blockchain but can be managed using an initial centralised Service
- Future iterations could leverage SPOs
- A richer set of communication tools will provide a richer User Experience with more enabled alerts, feedback and retain users in the ecosystem
- Working with an initial set of wallets and nodes to deploy and confirm the utility within phase 1 of the project. Phase 2 will focus on broadening the node-base and leveraging the Cardano infrastructure extending to the SPO network
- A well developed toolkit dedicated to embed of communication, open sourced to the communicty, can scale and meet the growing needs of Cardano DApp ecosystem. 
- Uses Cases in Social, Governance, Marketing and more general network wellness and belonging; need a Messaging Protocol with everyday utility

## Wallet-Centric ##
- With this Protocol, Wallets (or wallet-addresses) take a central and integral role in bringing communication to early adopters who wish to participate in designing utility and developer experience
- Making a more fluid experience where transaction signing is not required for each step also augments the experience. 

## What does it include ##
- Marketing Campaign broadcast, Governance updates, Events update, Alert & Notifications using a RSS variant 
- P2P like  library to allow chat (1-1, and fixed size group chat), embedded chat using wallet-addresses, peer to peer or in-DApp
- AI query toolkit to allow submit of graphql type queries against chain indexers and Oracles
- - engagement with data providers to collaborate on AI based services is anticipated
## How can this be done ##
- Establish focus group to refine proposed Use Cases:
    -- marketing / governance / alert-signals / collection of user feedback 
- Determine approach for an initial 'centralised' approach to gain support in Phase 1, present and rally support with Social Media (already proposed working with Anastasia Labs) 
- Leverage available technologies and focus on solving business need, with focus on Governance, Marketing and DApps in Phase 2

<src img="http://zeeyuu.io/images/Messaging_Protocol_App_Embed.gif"/>

## Technical Alignment ##

- The early stages of this project are likely using RSS-variant for broadcast, p2p variant for point to point, and AI approaches for advanced data extraction techniques for onchain stored data. These are not immediately requiring new protocols
- Any network gaps will be discussed with partners in Cardano L2 and emerging L2 teams for collaboration and reusability Opportunity
- Initial implementations will focus on 'smaller' payloads with focus on reliability and performance
- Alignment with established protocols will ensure focus on the key areas of adoption, user Experience and developer-experience is prioritised ; initially a REST API approach will likely be utilised with possible augmentation in line with CIP-95 

## Leveraging and Creating Utility in the DApp Community ##

- Publishing a proof of concept in phase 1 and roadshow with DApp community will be primary
- Publishing of measurements and KPIs for the core User Cases will be used to ensure milestones are met based on reliability and performance, ease of integration and adoption statistics

## Security and Quality of Service ##

- Focus on security will involve engagement with Cardano Network working group 
- No wallet address is exposed unless explicitly opted-in.

## Monetisation Opportunity ##
- Fee-based relaying or storage, earning rewards for uptime and quality of service (QoS).
- SPOs could optionally sign a PoS-based SLA with clients for QoS or storage guarantees, governed by on-chain reputation and stake-weighted scoring

## Who will we be engaging with ##
- DApps, Wallet builders, Cardano Networking Working Group
- Full-Node wallets e.g. Daedalus or Lace could fully participate in publishing/reading messages directly.
- Cardano Foundation 'cardano-wallet'
- Intersect Governance govtool
attributes.proposal_benefit:
## Supporting our Proposal ##

- Surveys by Gartner have evidence retention rates being highest on applications where chat features 1-1 and group are embedded. These applications create community and retain 20% more than DeFi. 
- Cardano currently offers email like communication which could be greatly enhanced by * Application Level Message Protocol [ALMP]* would the facility to unlock a new type of app (often referred to as SuperApp) 
- With a robust mechanism for applications in the Cardano Ecosystem to embed social features, bidirectional communication, topic broadcast this solution enables a new level of interactive conversation on Cardano
- Using the existing Wallet and permissionless model, also bring new utility (beyond DeFi and early stage Governance), users connecting via Wallet also brings value to the wallet community by providing access to community messaging, increase reconnect between projects and wallets holders.
- Having possibilty to converge social, governance, lifestyle and finance thru a new *Applicaiton Level Message Protocol [ALMP]* is a great uplift to Cardano
- we are optimising for messaging on social apps, application transactions status, governance broadcast type messages whilst enforcing anti-spam mechanisms reduces friction with moving parts of Cardano Blockchain

## Acceleration of Growth ##
- This protocol seeks to accelerate the build of inter-application messaging including
- - DApps can have a 1-1 
- - DApps can consider non-SPAM based Group chats
- - Social messaging trust reinforced wallet based security 
- Introduce utility and revenue earning mesh and potential utility yield for subscription based apps based on ability to join high value subscription services
- Augment recent Governance by providing channels for Community Announcements 
- Messaging with security bake-in for Micro-Purchases including Gaming /NFT minting
- Targeted positive developer experience in a messaging protocol with a smooth integration route for React, TypeScript and mobile builders 

## Availability and Target ##
- Priority integration into Cardano Governance process to enable ‘governance updates for the masses’ including ability for DReps to broadcast curated messages within agree message-etiquette around voting, preferences and leanings
- Ecosystem message broadcast without violating the anti-spam measurements, incorporating slashing approach where SPAM detected
- On-ramp for initial set of DApps and Wallets in Q3 2025 with SDK tutorials to allow expedited adoption
- Focus on initial centralised nodes to support the backend-messaging and security
- Broader adoption with target audience similar to CIP-95 by end of Q4 2025 Q1-2026
- Ability to integrate with Chat SDK to facilitate smooth onboarding using wallet based connection
- Integration of the messaging feature upgrades into Daedalus with provision of chat-sdks to other software wallets 

## New Sources of Value ##
- Use SPOs as reliable decentralized relays and store/forward nodes.
- Prevent spam through lightweight proof, rate limiting, and token bonding.
- Provide privacy through encrypted, ephemeral identities and routing obfuscation.
- Be modular enough to expand into notification services, governance signals, or collaborative DApps.

## Genesis + DHT-based protocol would ##
- Allow full-node/software/hardware wallets (via proxy) to communicate securely and anonymously and to receive updated on app-state, governance-actions, community-updates

attributes.proposal_description:
The Application Level Message Protocol scalable for social, def and technical Use Cases. This proposal centres on building a robust message protocol leveraging existing Proof of Stake infrastructure including established decentralised networks composed of Stake Pool Operators, Cardano Full Node operators, Full Node Wallets and Software Wallets. Taking this approach and using Distributed Hash Table [DHT], p2p lib-type equivalent features, we propose leveraging existing infrastructure endpoints to create a messaging protocol lookup and storage infrastructure whilst providing optional transfer anonymity and including anti-spam protection. Applying a DHT Based Messaging Infrastructure, messages can be stored and retrieved based on content hashes, not specific IPs or locations. In this protocol:
Messages or chat envelopes are stored in the DHT as encrypted blobs.


Keys in the DHT represent hashed topic identifiers, user IDs, or ephemeral keys.


Routing is handled by SPOs, who run full DHT nodes (like Kademlia), enabling high availability and persistence.


This protocol can also be tuned for message expiry, rate-limiting, and spam control could provide utility for social, financial and service oriented state messaging. 

SPOs, Full Nodes to serve as gateways and relay nodes:
They facilitate message propagation across the DHT.


Participate in gossip-type sync for higher redundancy and liveness.


Additionally offer Anonymous Data Advantages

Anonymity and censorship-resistance are achieved through:
Ephemeral or one-time chat IDs derived from key exchanges (e.g., Diffie-Hellman or Noise Protocol).


End-to-end encryption (E2EE) using X3DH + Double Ratchet (like Signal) over the DHT channel.


DHT obfuscation, where content is stored under content-addressed keys (like hash(sender_pubkey + timestamp)), making it hard to trace.


Future use of mixnets or dandelion routing to obscure initial message origin.


No wallet address is exposed unless explicitly opted-in.
fee-based relaying or storage, earning rewards for uptime and quality of service (QoS).


SPOs could optionally sign a PoS-based SLA with clients for QoS or storage guarantees, governed by on-chain reputation and stake-weighted scoring

Integration with Full Node, Hardware and Software Wallets
Full-Node wallets e.g. Daedalus or Lace could fully participate in publishing/reading messages directly.


Software wallets can fully participate in publishing/reading messages directly.


Hardware wallets (which are constrained) rely on trusted proxies (the wallet’s host app or a privacy-preserving SPO) to:


Fetch DHT entries related to their address or ephemeral chat handle.


Push messages signed by the hardware wallet to the DHT via a proxy.


In either case, the identity is never the wallet address. Use ephemeral DIDs (Decentralized Identifiers), session keys, or zero-knowledge proof tokens to maintain anonymity.

Messages or chat envelopes are stored in the DHT as encrypted blobs.


Keys in the DHT represent hashed topic identifiers, user IDs, or ephemeral keys.


Routing is handled by SPOs, who run full DHT nodes (like Kademlia), enabling high availability and persistence.


This protocol can also be tuned for message expiry, rate-limiting, and spam control could provide utility for social, financial and service oriented state messaging.

They facilitate message propagation across the DHT.

attributes.proposal_description:
The Application Level Message Protocol scalable for social, def and technical Use Cases. This proposal centres on building a robust message protocol leveraging existing Proof of Stake infrastructure including established decentralised networks composed of Stake Pool Operators, Cardano Full Node operators, Full Node Wallets and Software Wallets. Taking this approach and using Distributed Hash Table [DHT], p2p lib-type equivalent features, we propose leveraging existing infrastructure endpoints to create a messaging protocol lookup and storage infrastructure whilst providing optional transfer anonymity and including anti-spam protection. Applying a DHT Based Messaging Infrastructure, messages can be stored and retrieved based on content hashes, not specific IPs or locations. In this protocol:
Messages or chat envelopes are stored in the DHT as encrypted blobs.


Keys in the DHT represent hashed topic identifiers, user IDs, or ephemeral keys.


Routing is handled by SPOs, who run full DHT nodes (like Kademlia), enabling high availability and persistence.


This protocol can also be tuned for message expiry, rate-limiting, and spam control could provide utility for social, financial and service oriented state messaging. 

SPOs, Full Nodes to serve as gateways and relay nodes:
They facilitate message propagation across the DHT.


Participate in gossip-type sync for higher redundancy and liveness.


Additionally offer Anonymous Data Advantages

Anonymity and censorship-resistance are achieved through:
Ephemeral or one-time chat IDs derived from key exchanges (e.g., Diffie-Hellman or Noise Protocol).


End-to-end encryption (E2EE) using X3DH + Double Ratchet (like Signal) over the DHT channel.


DHT obfuscation, where content is stored under content-addressed keys (like hash(sender_pubkey + timestamp)), making it hard to trace.


Future use of mixnets or dandelion routing to obscure initial message origin.


No wallet address is exposed unless explicitly opted-in.
fee-based relaying or storage, earning rewards for uptime and quality of service (QoS).


SPOs could optionally sign a PoS-based SLA with clients for QoS or storage guarantees, governed by on-chain reputation and stake-weighted scoring

Integration with Full Node, Hardware and Software Wallets
Full-Node wallets e.g. Daedalus or Lace could fully participate in publishing/reading messages directly.


Software wallets can fully participate in publishing/reading messages directly.


Hardware wallets (which are constrained) rely on trusted proxies (the wallet’s host app or a privacy-preserving SPO) to:


Fetch DHT entries related to their address or ephemeral chat handle.


Push messages signed by the hardware wallet to the DHT via a proxy.


In either case, the identity is never the wallet address. Use ephemeral DIDs (Decentralized Identifiers), session keys, or zero-knowledge proof tokens to maintain anonymity.

attributes.proposal_benefit:
Application Level Message Protocol provides a mechanism for 1-1, Group communications between services-providers (1-1, 1-Many) bidirectional communication, 
optimised for messages suiting social apps, status update, transactions update and governance broadcast type messages; whilst enforcing anti-spam mechanisms reduces friction with moving parts of Cardano Blockchain
Packaging this accelerate the build of inter-application messaging including
- DApps can have a 1-1 
- DApps can consider non-SPAM based Group chats
- Social messaging trust reinforced using encryption and DIDs 
- Ability to introduce utility and revenue earning mesh and potential utility yield for subscription based apps
- Dedicate Topics available for Community Announcements including signals broadcasting for AI account rebalancing
- Messaging with security bake-in for Micro-Purchases including Gaming /NFT minting
- Targeted positive developer experience in a messaging protocol with a smooth integration route for React, TypeScript and mobile builders 
Availability and Target:
- On-ramp for large scale concurrent user based by end of 2025 Q1-2026
- Ability to integrate with Chat SDK to facilitate smooth onboarding of Users based on potential x509 certificate or DID
- Priority integration into Cardano Governance process to enable ‘governance updates for the masses’ including ability for - DReps to broadcast curated messages within agree message-etiquette around voting, preferences and leanings
- Ecosystem message broadcast without violating the anti-spam measurements, incorporating slashing approach where SPAM detected
- Integration of the messaging feature upgrades into Daedalus with provision of chat-sdks to other software wallets 


This DHT-based protocol would:
Allow full-node/software/hardware wallets (via proxy) to communicate securely and anonymously and to receive updated on app-state, governance-actions, community-updates


Use SPOs as reliable decentralized relays and store/forward nodes.


Prevent spam through lightweight proof, rate limiting, and token bonding.
 
Provide privacy through encrypted, ephemeral identities and routing obfuscation.


Be modular enough to expand into notification services, governance signals, or collaborative dApps.

Messages or chat envelopes are stored in the DHT as encrypted blobs.


Keys in the DHT represent hashed topic identifiers, user IDs, or ephemeral keys.

DHT obfuscation, where content is stored under content-addressed keys (like hash(sender_pubkey + timestamp)), making it hard to trace.

fee-based relaying or storage, earning rewards for uptime and quality of service (QoS).

Fetch DHT entries related to their address or ephemeral chat handle.

1) Can you get as many testimonials as possible from Cardano developers who will be consumers of the deliverables of this proposal? This would show that there is demand for the deliverables of this proposal among developers.

2) Is there concrete evidence that this proposal is well-socialized and supported within the Cardano community (e.g., social media engagement, public endorsements by DReps)?
on point '1' - yes reaching out to the DApp community, '2' - presented this at the Budget Proposal and equally reaching out DReps on this for support.

I would like to request additional information about the ALMP project. Could you provide details on the use cases identified through your focus groups, your specific plans for collaboration with wallet builders (particularly which wallets might become partners), and your partnership plans with Cardano Foundation 'cardano-wallet' and Intersect Governance govtool?

- Governance Action feedback from wallet holder to DRep by embedding 1-1 reply 
- DApp in DeFi or Utility informs a select user set of an upcoming 'alert' or meetup/ able to create a small group and take feedback
- Community / Social app can embed a 1-1 or small group chat which provides links to upcoming 'event of significance'
- Wallet holder can initiate an AI query like: where can I get best price for my tokens ABC-DEF (sample), this can potentially collaborate with an offchain indexer holding DEX and best prices where
- To date I have spoken to DEX, DApp and Protocol lab who see a set of stages/ initial proof-of-concept, mobilising an active community

Personally, it looks very good, but this proposal assumes that wallets and DApps will support it, but we have not yet confirmed which wallets and DApps will support it. It would be better to find a clear use case and confirm that wallets and DApps will support it before proceeding with the Budget proposal.
